full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media illustration shows a young man from the chest up, drawn in black and gray ink against bright orange poster-like marks. His head fills the upper center, short dark hair swept back in loose waves. He tilts his face upward and slightly to the right, looking beyond the top edge with wide, carefully drawn eyes. Strong dark brows and fine lashes frame the gaze. His mouth is closed and relaxed, while one hand rises beneath the chin, fingers folded against the cheek in a thoughtful pose. The pale shirt spreads across both lower corners, its collar open and its sleeves indicated by vigorous parallel lines. Dense hatching under the chin and along the neck creates the deepest shadow, while lighter strokes model the cheeks, nose, forehead, and knuckles. Behind the figure, rough fluorescent-orange strokes form broad vertical and diagonal bands. The orange does not fill the whole background; tan paper and fragments of old printed columns remain visible at the edges and through gaps. Most printed characters are cut off, faint, or too small to read. Scratches, rubbed patches, faint grid lines, and overlapping paper tones make the ground feel layered and used. The subject's pale face stands in strong contrast to both the bold orange and the black line work. Light in the drawing comes from the upper left, leaving the left forehead and nose bright while the underside of the hand and neck grow dark. The overall composition is close and upward-looking, balancing exacting ink modeling with abrupt color blocks and the rough texture of found paper.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介插画以黑灰墨线描绘一位取到胸部的年轻男子，背后是鲜橙色、如海报般的色痕。头部占据上方中央，短深发松松向后梳起。他抬脸略朝右，睁大的眼睛越过上缘望向远处，目光由精细绘出的眼睛呈现。浓重深眉和细睫毛框住视线。嘴巴合拢而放松，一只手抬到下巴下方，手指折起贴着脸颊，带着思索姿势。浅色衬衫铺向下方两角，衣领敞开，袖子由有力的平行线画出。下巴下方和颈侧的密集排线形成最深阴影，较轻笔触塑造脸颊、鼻子、额头和手指关节。人物背后，粗犷荧橙色笔迹构成宽阔的竖带与斜带。橙色并未填满整个背景；棕褐纸张与旧印刷栏目的碎片从边缘和空隙露出。多数印刷字符被裁掉、很淡或太小，无法读出。划痕、磨擦补丁、隐约网格线和叠压的纸张色调让底面像反复使用的材料。浅色面孔与醒目橙色和黑色线条都形成强烈对照。画中光来自左上，左额和鼻子明亮，手掌下缘与颈部逐渐变暗。整体构图紧密而目光向上，以精确的墨线塑形平衡突然出现的色块与旧纸的粗糙肌理。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media illustration pairs finely hatched black line work with abrupt flat accents of vivid orange. Cream and tan paper remain visible beneath the marks, carrying print fragments, scratches, faint rules, and rubbed areas that suggest a layered found surface. Dark strokes gather into solid shadow in some areas and separate into thin parallel threads elsewhere, giving volume without a smooth airbrushed finish. Large angular color blocks interrupt the intricate monochrome drawing and push it forward. Clean light regions are deliberately preserved between the densest black and the loudest orange, keeping the image readable at close range. Directional illumination is described through line density and selective pale highlights rather than glossy effects. The frame is tightly cropped around one strong central mass, while partial marks continue beyond the edges. The overall effect is urgent and graphic, with precise hand drawing set against rough, energetic print texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种混合媒介插画把细密排线的黑色线描与突然出现的鲜橙平涂重音并置。奶油色和棕褐纸张从笔迹下露出，带着印刷碎片、划痕、淡线和磨擦区域，暗示层叠的现成材料表面。深色笔迹在部分区域聚成实心阴影，在别处又分开为细密平行线，因此建立体积，却没有喷绘般平滑的完成面。宽大棱角色块切入复杂的单色绘画，把它向前推出。最密的黑与最响亮的橙之间刻意保留干净浅色区，使近距离画面仍可辨。定向光通过线条密度和选择性的浅亮部表现，而非光滑特效。画幅紧密裁住一个强中央体块，局部痕迹继续越过边缘。整体效果急促而图形化，精确手绘与粗糙、充满活力的印刷肌理互相碰撞。
theme_en: A black-ink portrait of a thoughtful young man against orange poster marks
theme_zh: 橙色海报笔迹前，一位凝神仰望的年轻男子黑墨肖像
name: David Bromley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
